name: implemented-by-migration
body:
Because language rooting changes every code FQN, every existing authored `implemented-by` edge target — which the ingestor validates against the scanned code universe (real code FQNs from `graph.jsonl`, src/layers.rs `classify_code_ref`) — is reported as DRIFT unless it is migrated to its rooted FQN. This change-set therefore migrates every existing `implemented-by` target to the rooted form.

The migration is sequenced AFTER the FQN change, with a planned-node bridge that makes every intermediate mutation valid: (1) the Language node + rooted FQNs land in code; (2) every authored `implemented-by` target's rooted destination FQN is FIRST declared as a planned Implementation node (`apg plan add <project> planned <kind> <rooted-fqn>`), so `classify_code_ref` grades it Pending rather than Drift — only a `Record::PlannedNode` enters the planned universe, a rename `--to` does not (`apg.artifacts::code_universes_from_export`, `apg.plan_cmd::task_verb_universes`); (3) every authored `implemented-by` edge is re-pointed bare→rooted with `apg edge rm implemented-by <solution-node> <bare-fqn>` + `apg edge add implemented-by <solution-node> <rooted-fqn>` (each replacement atomic — both halves rewritten, no orphaned half) — this validates as Pending because of step (2); (4) the branch is re-scanned: the scanner realizes the planned nodes (the rooted code FQNs now exist, planned records replaced by real ones) and `ingest_tree` finds every authored target Real → no drift; (5) `apg plan verify` / the next scan confirms no drift and the spine query reaches rooted code FQNs. The migration therefore runs BEFORE the branch re-scan — the planned-node bridge is exactly what makes migrating before the re-scan valid; migrating before the bridge (or re-scanning before the edges are re-pointed) is what is forbidden. This is a data/layer migration, not net-new code: it uses the existing node/edge mutation surface.

Acceptance: after migration, every authored `implemented-by` target resolves against the scanned code universe (no DRIFT on the next scan/validate); no `implemented-by` target remains at an unrooted FQN; the spine query reaches rooted code FQNs; each re-pointed edge has both halves present (the node-file pairing is consistent); `apg plan verify` does not refuse for a missing/drifted implementation target.
